name: api
description: Cloudflare Worker API for the White Point Survey family of web applications

scripts.d1:migrate:v1:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply compass --local --env production
scripts.d1:migrate:v1:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply compass --remote --env production
scripts.d1:migrate:ns:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply northstar --local --env production --config wrangler.v2.toml
scripts.d1:reset:ns:local: wrangler d1 execute northstar --local --env production --config wrangler.v2.toml --file=./scripts/reset-northstar-local.sql && pnpm run d1:migrate:ns:local
scripts.d1:migrate:ns:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply northstar --remote --env production --config wrangler.v2.toml
scripts.d1:migrate:ns:preview:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply northstar --remote --env preview --config wrangler.v2.toml
